obj/back-to-the-stage.text: A horn from the bay. Three low boats with striped sails: raiders, come for the festival and, says Hedda, very specifically for the cake.
Bernt has carted the castle's crossbows down to the stage with whatever rockets the day saved. 'Load the rocket where the bolt goes. Point it at the boats. Not at the cake.'

on_respawn.text: You come round on a bench in the inn's taproom across the square. Somebody has left you a pie.

on_complete.text: Runa watches the show from the square, a carrot in her pocket for the mare back in her stall.
Out on the flank a lantern bobs between the orchard trees: Runa, still calling for her mare, missing every rocket.
The lighthouse beam sweeps over the square, and every face turns up into it as it passes.
On the stroke of midnight the festival bell rings the festival in.
The feast is laid out along the square: smoked fish, cheeses, honey cakes and a whole ham, all fished out of the bay this morning.
The feast tables hold bread, a great deal of bread, and a single heroic cheese.
Kettil's three goats watch the festival from their pen on the main street, chewing in time with the music.
Kettil's two goats watch the festival from their pen on the main street. Kettil watches them, and not the rockets.

on_complete.text: Three goats stand on the stage through the whole speech, and the Admiral eats a page of it.
Oskar's cake stands on the stage, four tiers and a sugar lighthouse, without a mark on it.
Hedda gives the toast to the cake's empty plate, and the town toasts the plate.

on_complete.text: The castle's fireworks fill the whole sky over the town, and keep filling it until the dogs give up barking.
A few rockets go up, one after another, a polite gap between each. The town cheers every one of them, individually.

on_complete.text: The first pig crosses the quay by a snout. The board on the square says who came in where; the town will argue about it until next year.

effects.text: Runa counts your pennies twice and leads Moss out to the hitching rail by the square. 'Not past dusk. And she does not like the sea.'
Runa looks at your pennies and then at you. 'That is not a horse's worth.'

effects.line: You hired Moss from Runa for four Festival Pennies.

offers.label: Hire the grey mare (4 pennies)
offers.tooltip: Moss, the grey mare, saddled, until dusk.

effects.text: Oskar wraps three loaves in a cloth. 'Not on the cake's table, please.'
Oskar looks at your empty hand. 'Bread is a penny. Even today.'
Oskar hands over a pie as if it were a small cake. 'Eat it sitting down.'
Oskar looks at your empty hand. 'Pie is a penny. Even today.'

offers.label: A pumpkin pie (1 penny)
offers.tooltip: A whole pie, for the road.

effects.text: Torvald lays a sword across your palms. 'Edge out. Always edge out.'
Torvald counts your pennies, then the sword's worth. 'No.'

offers.label: An iron sword (3 pennies)
offers.tooltip: Torvald's own work, balanced for a hand like yours.

effects.text: Torvald knocks twice on the shield and hands it over. 'It will take more than that.'
Torvald counts your pennies, then the shield's worth. 'No.'

offers.label: A shield (2 pennies)
offers.tooltip: Oak boards and an iron rim.

effects.text: Torvald sets the helmet on your head himself and nods at it.
Torvald counts your pennies, then the helmet's worth. 'No.'

offers.label: An iron helmet (2 pennies)
offers.tooltip: For a head that walks into things.

effects.text: Torvald buckles the breastplate on you and steps back to look. 'Good.'
Torvald counts your pennies, then the plate's worth. 'No.'

offers.label: An iron breastplate (3 pennies)
offers.tooltip: Plate for the chest, hammered this winter.

effects.text: Torvald pockets the pennies without counting them. 'Charcoal. Bellows. A week of my sleep. He will be on the square when the sun goes down.'
Torvald shakes his head. 'Waking him costs five. Charcoal is not free, even on a holiday.'

offers.label: Wake the iron man for the dusk (5 pennies)
offers.tooltip: Torvald's iron man, with his new head, walks down to the square at dusk and stands with you.
